title: Find female patients diagnosed with SLE who have at least one laboratory te
question: Find female patients diagnosed with SLE who have at least one laboratory test showing elevated hematocrit (HCT ≥ 50). For these patients, return their ID, age, and average albumin level across all their lab tests.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    T1."XCL_058" AS PatientID,
    T2."XCL_016" AS Age,
    AVG(T2."XCL_031") AS AvgAlbumin
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE
    T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
    AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
    AND T1."XCL_058" IN (
        SELECT T2_sub."XCL_014"
        FROM Laboratory AS T2_sub
        WHERE T2_sub."XCL_033" >= 50
    )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T2."XCL_016"

    T2."XCL_016" AS Age,

GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T2."XCL_016"

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    T1."XCL_058" AS PatientID,
    (STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('NOW')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")) AS Age,
    AVG(T2."XCL_021") AS AvgAlbumin
FROM 
    Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE 
    T1."XCL_059" = 'F' 
    AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
    AND T1."XCL_058" IN (
        SELECT T2_sub."XCL_014"
        FROM Laboratory AS T2_sub
        WHERE T2_sub."XCL_016" >= 50
    )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_060"
